'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[2025 Houthi attack on Tel Aviv airport]]
***A [[ballistic missile]] launched from [[Houthi-controlled territory of Yemen|Houthi-controlled Yemen]] hits near [[Ben Gurion International Airport]] in [[Central District (Israel)|Central District]], [[Israel]], injuring eight people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-military-says-working-intercepting-missile-launched-yemen-2025-05-04/ (Reuters)] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2025/05/04/houthi-missile-strikes-israel-main-airport/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese Civil War]]
**The [[Rapid Support Forces]] launch [[Drone warfare|drone attacks]] on [[Port Sudan]]'s [[Port Sudan New International Airport|international civilian]] and [[Port Sudan Military Airport|military airport]]. Drones also hit an [[ammunition depot]] at [[Osman Digna]] Air Base, causing damage but no casualties. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/4/sudans-rsf-carries-out-drone-attack-near-port-sudan-airport-army (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces he will introduce 100% tariffs on foreign [[movie film|films]] brought into the [[United States]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/may/04/trump-tariffs-foreign-movies (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Ninoy Aquino International Airport car crash]]
**Two people are killed and four others are injured after a car crashes into an entrance of [[Ninoy Aquino International Airport]] in [[Metro Manila]], [[Philippines]]. The driver of the car is in [[Philippine National Police|police]] custody. [https://apnews.com/article/manila-airport-crash-vehicle-suv-deaths-philippines-91d3ff57b8f8f2082730c20cf52115c0 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/several-injured-car-crashes-into-entrance-manila-airport-local-media-say-2025-05-04/ (Reuters)] [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2058197/naia-t1-incident-2 (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
*[[Port of Shahid Rajaee explosion]]
**The casualty figure from the explosion at the [[Port of Shahid Rajaee]] in [[Hormozgan province]], [[Iran]], is revised by the [[Chief Justice of Iran|judiciary of Iran]] to 57 deaths and more than 1,000 injuries. Two people, including a government official, are arrested in connection with the explosion. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2599520/middle-east (Arab News)]
*[[Bayesian (yacht)#Sinking and aftermath|Sinking of the ''Bayesian'']]
**Marine salvage experts begin operations to recover the [[superyacht]] [[Bayesian (yacht)|''Bayesian'']] which sank in August 2024 and killed seven people, including British billionaire tech magnate [[Mike Lynch (businessman)|Mike Lynch]] and members of his family. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/experts-start-complex-recovery-of-a-superyacht-that-sank-off-sicily-killing-7/ (CTV News)]
*Ten people are killed and 70 others are rescued and hospitalized after two passenger boats carrying 84 people [[Capsizing|capsize]] on the [[Wu River (Yangtze tributary)|Wu River]] near [[Qianxi, Guizhou|Qianxi]], [[Guizhou]], [[China]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/three-dead-60-hospitalised-in-china-boat-disasters-state-media-1ac9c226 (''Barron's'')] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/2-boats-capsized-in-chinas-southwest-after-sudden-storm-leaving-20-missing/ (CTV News)] [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3309038/2-boats-capsize-heavy-rain-southwest-china-dozens-plunged-river (SCMP)]
*At least three people are killed, fifteen others are injured, including children, and several apartments are destroyed in a [[gas explosion]] at an apartment block in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]]. [https://unn.ua/en/news/a-gas-explosion-in-a-residential-building-in-moscow-two-dead-6-injured (UNN)] [https://news.az/news/powerful-blast-rocks-residential-building-in-moscow-video (News.AZ)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Two people are arrested after planning to [[terrorism in Brazil|carry out attacks]] with [[improvised explosive device]]s at [[Lady Gaga]]'s [[Mayhem promotional concerts|concert]] with more than two million attendees on [[Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro|Copacabana Beach]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]], to gain notoriety on social media. The suspects spread hate speech, mainly against children, adolescents and the [[LGBTQIA+]] community. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c209r5pqzneo (BBC News)]
 
*Thirteen [[Gold mining|gold mine]] security guards that were abducted in an [[ambush]] last month in [[Pataz province]], [[Peru]], are found dead. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/13-workers-kidnapped-from-a-peruvian-gold-mine-are-found-dead/ (CTV News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Romanian presidential election]]
**The first round of the [[Romania]]n [[President of Romania|presidential]] election is held with eleven candidates on the ballot. [[George Simion]] leads the first round with 40% of the vote. As no candidate has won over 50% of the vote, a [[two-round system|run-off]] between the first two candidates will be held on May 18. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj0zl1702ego (BBC News)]
*[[2025 Lebanese municipal elections]]
**First round of voting in the Lebanese municipal elections begin in the [[Mount Lebanon Governorate]] and [[Keserwan-Jbeil Governorate]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/middle-east/lebanon-local-elections-rcna204708 (NBC News)]
